title: Naturally Crumbly Italian Veal Vitello Tonnato
description: A pungent and crumbly Italian dish featuring soured cream and chive dip, pickle, and raw-friendly veal, originating from the Venetian region. This festive dish is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Pound the veal cutlets to a thickness of about 1/4 inch to ensure even cooking.
Season the veal with salt and black pepper to enhance the flavor.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the veal for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Let the veal rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
In a bowl, mix together the soured cream, chives, pickles, capers, and lemon juice to create the dip.
Serve the sliced veal with the soured cream and chive dip spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional chives and capers if desired.
Refrigerate any leftovers promptly to ensure food safety.
